backend/main.mo: Main backend canister defining data models, storage maps, authorization mixins, and inventory/sales/customer/supplier/closure types with initial state setup.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing files, components, and tests supporting the artifacts download UI feature.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short human-written summaries of many frontend source files.
frontend/artifacts/.gitkeep: Empty placeholder file to keep the artifacts directory in version control.
frontend/artifacts/DEPLOY_README.md: Deployment instructions describing package contents and steps after extracting app-build.zip.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining light/dark theme CSS variables and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/public/artifacts/.gitkeep: Empty placeholder file to keep the public artifacts directory in version control.
frontend/scripts/generate-source-documen: Shell script that generates SOURCE_CODE.md by enumerating project files and embedding their contents.
frontend/scripts/package-artifact.sh: Shell script that builds backend/frontend, generates documentation, and packages deployable and source ZIP artifacts.
frontend/scripts/README.md: Documentation for build artifact packaging workflow describing generated ZIPs and usage of scripts.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router setup wiring all ERP routes through AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/artifacts/Artifa: Displays a dialog listing downloadable artifacts, showing availability and enabling file downloads.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthControl: Provides sign‑in/sign‑out UI using Internet Identity, handling login states and clearing cached queries.
frontend/src/components/customers/Overdu: Shows an alert or badge indicating customers with overdue credit, optionally including name or count.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Invent: Form dialog for creating or editing inventory items with image upload, pricing logic, and authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/LargeButton.tsx: Wrapper around shadcn Button applying consistent large sizing and styling.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout with navigation, global search, data exports, artifact downloads, and alert counters.
frontend/src/components/sales/SalesError: Error boundary for sales views that displays an error card with details and reset options.
frontend/src/components/search/GlobalSea: Modal search interface that performs debounced intelligent search and navigates to selected results.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and refreshes the backend actor based on identity changes and invalidates dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthBootstrap.ts: Bootstraps authenticated users by ensuring a profile exists after login and suppresses duplicate errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Returns a debounced version of a value that updates after a delay.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating inventory, sales, rates, suppliers, and related data via the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useStaticArtifactAvai: Checks availability of static build artifacts via HEAD requests and caches results briefly.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and theme variables defining light and dark mode color tokens.
frontend/src/lib/csvExport.ts: Utility to escape CSV values, convert arrays to CSV, and trigger CSV downloads.
frontend/src/lib/currency.ts: Currency formatting utilities and USD-to-VES/COP conversion helpers.
frontend/src/lib/datasetSerializers.ts: Serializers converting backend entities into CSV-ready row arrays plus predefined CSV headers.
frontend/src/lib/errorMessage.ts: Extracts readable error messages from various error formats, including IC agent patterns.
frontend/src/lib/fileToBytes.ts: Converts File objects to byte arrays and provides a helper to create image URLs from bytes.
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Defines a large union of translation keys for the type‑safe i18n system.
frontend/src/lib/inventoryPricing.ts: Provides utility functions to calculate selling prices from margins and derive margins from prices.
frontend/src/lib/salesCart.ts: Implements cart item types and helpers for cloning items, validating stock, pricing, subtotals, and cart updates.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Contains a className merger and a simple unique ID generator.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/CashboxPage.tsx: Renders cashbox balances, lists entries, and provides a form to add new cashbox entries with filtering.
frontend/src/pages/ClosuresPage.tsx: Displays closure history and allows creating new closures by calculating balances and income/expenses.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerDetailPage.ts: Shows customer details with edit functionality, validation, and not‑found handling.
frontend/src/pages/CustomersPage.tsx: Customer list and delinquency indicators with dialogs for creating and editing customers using query hooks and identity checks.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard showing inventory, customer, delinquency, and cashbox KPIs with alerts for low stock and overdue sales.
frontend/src/pages/InventoryPage.tsx: Inventory listing with category filters, low‑stock alerts, and a form for adding or editing items.
frontend/src/pages/RatesPage.tsx: Exchange rate viewer and form for authenticated users to add new USD→VES/COP rates.
frontend/src/pages/SalesPage.tsx: Sales interface with product search, cart management, pricing modes, and sale submission.
frontend/src/pages/SupplierDetailPage.ts: Detail page that loads a supplier by ID, shows its info, and provides an edit dialog with update handling and authentication checks.
frontend/src/pages/SuppliersPage.tsx: Main supplier list with create and edit dialogs, authentication-based actions, and navigation to individual supplier details.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based routing parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration extending typography, colors, fonts, animations, and layout settings.
project_state.json: JSON metadata describing the project state, feature requests, and architectural notes for the Speed Motors ERP.
